starting_safe_region_art_v2.prompt: Create a premium, richly detailed 2D top-down orthographic fantasy RPG WORLD MAP BACKGROUND, landscape 3:2 composition, no perspective, no isometric angle, no UI, no text, no labels, no icons, no characters, no border. The map is one continuous lush temperate valley with four clearly separated settlements in fixed positions: a large fortified medieval stone city in the exact center (about 50% width, 48% height), a small golden wheat farming village in the northwest (about 20% width, 25% height), a cozy deep-green woodland village in the northeast (about 83% width, 28% height), and a rugged slate-and-ore mining village in the south (about 50% width, 84% height). Connect all four settlements with winding natural packed-earth roads that meet at the central city gates. Add a winding blue river across the upper third with two elegant stone bridges, rolling grassy meadows, dense varied forest groves around the eastern woodland, patchwork crop fields and orchards around the northwest farm, rocky hills, quarry terraces and mine entrances around the southern mining village. The central city has a visible outer stone wall, multiple distinct roof clusters, a central circular market plaza and a keep. Distinct architectural silhouettes and regional palettes. Natural irregular terrain boundaries, small footpaths, hedgerows, garden plots, streams, scattered boulders, warm sunlight, painterly hand-painted game environment, extremely polished professional RPG map art, fine texture detail, cohesive color grading, readable layout at small mobile screen scale. Keep all four settlements and connecting roads clearly visible and spatially separated. Background fills the entire canvas edge to edge.
starting_safe_region_art_v2.description: High-detail illustrated top-down playable world map for ETRANOM's safe starting region, replacing the earlier flat and generic map art.

Central fortified stone city, northwest agricultural village, northeast timber forest village, southern mining village, connected by winding cobblestone roads. River, bridges, crop fields, dark pine groves, log piles, cabins, rocky hills, mine and smelter. Continuous cohesive world, no UI, text, labels, icons, characters, watermark or border.
etranom_safe_region_night_atlas_v3.description: Nighttime dark-fantasy illustrated world map with a fortified central city, three connected safe villages, lantern-lit roads, forests, fields and mining hills.
